title: Resolve postponed annotations during command signature inspection
answers: Why do commands fail in modules using from __future__ import annotations?
How should command signatures handle string annotations?
Where must command signature inspection evaluate annotations?
body:
Symptom: Commands defined in modules using `from __future__ import annotations` fail to execute.
Root cause: `mitmproxy/command.py:Command` and `mitmproxy/command.py:verify_arg_signature` inspected signatures without evaluating string annotations.
Fix pattern: Use `inspect.signature(..., eval_str=True)` in both command signature construction and argument-signature verification.
Constraints: Applies to command callable inspection, including postponed annotations; preserve the existing `sig.bind(*args, **kwargs)` argument validation.
applies: Command signature construction and argument verification in mitmproxy/command.py.
